integrity: The verifier reconstructs all faces from the complete 100-tetrahedron presentation, proves H1=Z plus two order-two factors from an exact maximal-minor determinant, mod-two rank, and a primitive integral cocycle, then exhausts every three-vertex clique and computes exact mixed free-torsion coordinates.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns simplicial edge length in the fixed sixteen-vertex G2 triangulation. The torsion-coordinate basis is computational rather than canonical, and the result does not compare other triangulations or Euclidean metric systoles. The exact facet table is undated, so the date field uses the earliest inspected day-resolved source explicitly reporting the same sixteen-vertex G2 face vector.
title: Every empty triangle is essential in the sixteen-vertex \(\mathcal G_2\) flat manifold
